Definition: from G2325; reaping, i.e. the crop:--harvest.
BiblicalUsage: The word therismós carries the sense of harvest, reaping. In Matthew 9:37, The harvest truly is plenteous. The word turns up 8 times, and each time it points to the same reality.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the harvest is God’s work first and mine second, and I am only a worker sent into fields He has already ripened. That is why therismós stays with me long after the verse is closed.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
